citeAs: Peng, Y., Shakeel, M., Sudo, Y., Chen, W., Tian, J., Lin, C.-J., Watanabe, S. (2025). OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning. Interspeech 2025.
creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe (Carnegie Mellon University; Honda Research Institute Japan)
description: A cleaned and filtered subset of the YODAS web-crawled speech dataset, produced via a scalable data-cleaning pipeline (resegmentation, LID-based filtering, and CTC-score-based filtering). The resulting dataset contains 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, suitable for multilingual ASR training in the Whisper-style framework.
name: espnet_yodas_owsmv4 (Cleaned YODAS for OWSM v4)
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations (transcriptions with timestamps) were originally provided by YODAS from web-crawled sources. The cleaning pipeline realigns audio and text using CTC segmentation, filters by language ID consistency (text and audio LID must match original label), and filters by CTC confidence score threshold (θCTC=0.10 quantile per language).
rai:dataBiases: The distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share (74.6k hours out of 166k total), whereas many other languages are underrepresented. The authors explicitly note this imbalance and choose not to resample.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled speech dataset. YODAS provides unsegmented long-form recordings with text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps, crawled from the web across 149 languages and 370k hours. The cleaned subset was produced by applying a three-step pipeline: resegmentation, LID-based filtering, and CTC-score-based filtering.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw YODAS data: 370k hours of unsegmented long-form audio recordings in 149 languages, web-crawled and released under a Creative Commons license, accompanied by text transcriptions with start and end timestamps.
rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments. Even after cleaning, the language distribution remains highly imbalanced with English dominating and many languages underrepresented. The OWSM-CTC v3.2 model used for resegmentation supports only a subset of the languages present in YODAS.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Three-step pipeline: (1) Resegmentation — audio and text realigned using CTC segmentation algorithm with OWSM-CTC v3.2; long-form recordings segmented into utterances of max 30 seconds; non-speech utterances removed; yielding 345k hours across 83 languages. (2) LID-based filtering — text LID (fastText) and spoken LID (ECAPA-TDNN/SpeechBrain) applied; only utterances where original language label matches both predicted labels retained; yielding 284k hours across 75 languages. (3) CTC-score-based filtering — utterances with CTC confidence scores in the lowest θCTC=0.10 quantile per language discarded; yielding 166k hours across 75 languages.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset advances open and reproducible speech research by providing a large-scale, freely licensed multilingual ASR resource. It enables academic institutions to train competitive speech foundation models without proprietary data, addressing concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility in speech AI.
rai:dataUseCases: Multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) training, particularly for Whisper-style speech foundation models. Also supports spoken language identification (LID) and potentially speech translation (ST) as part of the broader OWSM training pipeline.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: OWSM-CTC v3.2 (for CTC segmentation/resegmentation and confidence scoring); fastText (text-based language identification); ECAPA-TDNN from SpeechBrain (spoken language identification)

null_reasons.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: No annotation platform used; data is web-crawled with automated cleaning pipeline, no crowdsourcing platform mentioned.

evidence.isLiveDataset: we create a higher-quality subset with 166k hours of speech in 75 languages. Furthermore, we train a new series of OWSM v4 models using this curated dataset alongside existing OWSM data.
evidence.rai:dataCollection: YODAS establishes a scalable pipeline to crawl data from the web. The current version already includes 370k hours of audio in 149 languages. YODAS provides unsegmented long-form recordings, each of them is accompanied by a list of text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.
evidence.rai:dataCollectionType: YODAS establishes a scalable pipeline to crawl data from the web. The current version already includes 370k hours of audio in 149 languages.
evidence.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The current version already includes 370k hours of audio in 149 languages. YODAS provides unsegmented long-form recordings, each of them is accompanied by a list of text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps. However, these timestamps can be inaccurate.
evidence.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: our first step is to realign the audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm. Following realignment, the long-form audio recordings are segmented into shorter utterances, each with a maximum duration of 30 seconds. Utterances that consist exclusively of non-speech elements, such as music, are removed. The processed dataset comprises 345k hours of audio across 83 languages.
evidence.rai:dataBiases: Similar to the raw YODAS data, the distribution across languages is highly imbalanced. English constitutes the largest share, whereas many other languages continue to be underrepresented. For simplicity, in this work, we keep the original distribution without any resampling.
evidence.rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data has not undergone a rigorous cleaning process and may contain annotation errors. Common issues include mismatched language labels and misalignment between audio and text. we employ the publicly available OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, which supports only a subset of the languages present in YODAS.
evidence.rai:dataUseCases: By applying it to YODAS, we create an ASR dataset with 166k hours of audio in 75 languages. We develop a new series of OWSM v4 models using this curated data alongside the previous OWSM v3.2 data.
evidence.rai:machineAnnotationTools: we employ the publicly available OWSM-CTC v3.2 model, which supports only a subset of the languages present in YODAS. the text-based LID model is sourced from fastText, while the spoken LID model is based on ECAPA-TDNN, developed by SpeechBrain.
evidence.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: YODAS provides unsegmented long-form recordings, each of them is accompanied by a list of text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps. However, these timestamps can be inaccurate. Consequently, our first step is to realign the audio and text using the CTC segmentation algorithm.
evidence.rai:dataSocialImpact: To advance open research, researchers from academic institutions have developed a series of fully open Whisper-style speech models (OWSM) using publicly available data and an open source toolkit, ESPnet. To advance academic research, we will publicly release our data-cleaning scripts, the curated YODAS dataset, training code, pre-trained models, and training logs.
